- Root P0 Medicaid plan appeal. Prerequisite sentences on its documents:

  - Computation `medicaid_plan_appeal_amount` 2: "The plan appeal's disputed charges are not fixed until each authorization denial on the claim carries a corrected claim."
- P0 <- P1 (state-derived): plan paying first = Gulf Coast; its claim for order 8872e57e (C3260708318) has no appeal. A member appeal on an OON plan that pays first is the write described by `first_plan_member_appeal_filing_reference` ("A patient may appeal the denials of an out-of-network health plan that pays first for them ... `sign_primary_member_appeal_ad6f2953`").
- P1 <- P3 (state-derived): `first_plan_member_appeal_amount` §2: "The first-plan member appeal's contested charges are not fixed until the coverage carries a coordination claim, filed within those six months, answering its other-coverage denial." Record CO-22 on C3260522304, none answered. Write: `coordination_correction_claim_reference` ("refiles the claim with the patient's current coordination of benefits").
- P0 <- P2 (state-derived): CO-197 on C3260825442 without corrected claim; write: `authorization_correction_claim_reference` ("An authorization denial is cured by an authorization correction where the order carries an approved authorization").
- Order: P3 -> P1 -> P0; P2 -> P0. No pre-solved hop: no other problem's tool or route appears in any blocked document.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the one thing": filing the Lone Star appeal now leaves its amount unrecordable (Gulf Coast claim carries no member appeal) and disputed charges unfixed (CO-197 not corrected).
- Closest alternatives excluded: appealing CO-197 instead of correcting — `appeal_filing_rules` 1 (appeal only when no retroactive authorization; here the order carries one) and `denial_liability_and_cures` retired/current basis; lab filing the Gulf Coast appeal — OON needs patient authorization; Gulf Coast as secondary — Medicaid pays last; a coordination detail update before the coordination claim — the current basis applies "where the coverage's coordination order on file already gives it the payment position", which holds; the retired clause requiring an update after the denial is visibly retired.
- Fall-back numbers: 186.00 / 111.60 / 79.00 / 245.00 vs 80.42 / 19.24 / 76.46 / 127.20 — all definite and different.
- Observations for the scan: `medicaid_claim_arrival_percent` titles the factor "Arrival Percent" but calls it "crossover percent" in body (a word the corpus also uses for automatic Medicare crossover); `medicaid_appeal_interest_days` uses "the date the claim reached it" whose meaning (submission date) is stated in the arrival doc, not in the interest-days doc itself.
